gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histopathologically proven newly diagnosed primary glioblastoma.

candidate_evidence.quote: This phase I trial aims to determine the safety and tolerability of the PEP-CMV vaccine in patients with newly diagnosed MGMT-unmethylated GBM in combination with one cycle of adjuvant temozolomide.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Histopathologically proven newly diagnosed primary glioblastoma.

role_evidence.quote: The PEP-CMV vaccine is a long synthetic peptide (PEP) made up of 26 amino acids that is derived from the human cytomegalovirus (CMV) matrix protein pp65 and has both MHC class I and II epitopes.

agents.drug_class_hint: cancer peptide vaccine (CMV pp65 long synthetic peptide)

role_evidence.quote: in combination with one cycle of adjuvant temozolomide
A vaccine platform that initially consists of TMZ-induced lymphopenia and Td pre-conditioning will be used

agents.drug_class_hint: alkylating agent; established GBM therapy (standard adjuvant)

role_evidence.quote: To ensure the effectiveness of the future Td pre-conditioning, which is given right before the initial PEP-CMV vaccine, a Td booster is required at enrollment.

agents.drug_class_hint: tetanus-diphtheria toxoid used as immune pre-conditioning for the vaccine

source_quote.quote: Patients must have tumours which are MGMT-unmethylated.

coder_notes: Phase 1 peptide cancer vaccine (PEP-CMV) with adjuvant temozolomide and Td pre-conditioning: excluded intervention type at S6. Td listed as supportive (conditioning for the vaccine, by analogy with R6); it is a non-cancer vaccine, could alternatively be listed as excluded_intervention_type. CMV seropositivity is an eligibility requirement but is host serology, not a tumour molecular biomarker, so not recorded. ELISPOT immune response is a vaccine immunogenicity endpoint; no candidate, so target_engagement_planned coded no.
